name: Exp_RMACD
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorRMACD indicator, a volume-weighted MACD variant with customizable signal line smoothing. It offers four entry algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD/signal line crossover. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable buy/sell permissions and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorRMACD指标进行交易，这是一种带成交量加权的MACD变体，支持自定义信号线平滑方法。它提供四种入场算法：零线突破、MACD方向变化、信号线方向变化以及MACD与信号线交叉。根据这些动量信号开平仓，并支持可配置的买卖权限和固定止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于RMACD（成交量加权MACD）指标的动量信号进行交易。入场条件有四种模式可选：零线突破模式检测MACD柱状图穿越零线；MACD转向模式检测MACD柱状图方向变化；信号线转向模式检测信号线方向变化；MACD交叉模式检测MACD柱状图与信号线的交叉。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面没有加仓或减仓逻辑，每笔交易独立计算仓位大小。策略使用CXMA类支持多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、T3、VIDYA、AMA等），增强了信号线的灵活性。EA在新K线形成时检测信号，避免同根K线重复交易，但缺少点差过滤和滑点保护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on momentum signals from the RMACD indicator, which is a volume-weighted MACD variant. Entry conditions offer four selectable modes: zero-line breakout detects the MACD histogram crossing zero; MACD twist detects directional change in the MACD histogram; signal twist detects directional change in the signal line; and MACD disposition detects crossovers between the MACD histogram and signal line. Exit conditions include reverse signal-triggered closes and fixed stop-loss/take-profit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management lacks scaling logic, with each trade independently calculating position size. The strategy leverages the CXMA class supporting multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.), enhancing signal line flexibility. The EA detects signals on new bar formation to avoid repeated trades on the same bar, but lacks spread filtering and explicit slippage protection beyond the Deviation parameter.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or lot size; negative value = fixed lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大允许价格偏差点数

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：零线突破/MACD转向/信号线转向/MACD交叉
parameters.description_en: Entry mode: zero-line breakout / MACD reversal / signal line reversal / MACD crossover

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型（跳数/真实成交量）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 提供四种入场算法模式，策略灵活可配置
支持多种高级平滑算法（JJMA、JurX、T3等），信号线质量优于传统MACD
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线重复交易
买卖方向可独立控制，支持只做单向交易
止损止盈参数齐全，基础风险控制到位
pros_en: Four entry algorithm modes provide flexible and configurable strategy options
Supports multiple advanced smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, T3, etc.), yielding higher quality signal lines than traditional MACD
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same bar
Buy and sell directions can be independently controlled, supporting one-directional-only trading
Complete stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动率，缺乏ATR动态止损
MM参数正值模式的资金管理逻辑依赖外部库，可读性差
没有持仓检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
信号逻辑中Value数组索引方向与CopyBuffer返回顺序需仔细确认，容易出错
cons_en: Lacks spread filtering, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not adapt to varying market volatility; no ATR-based dynamic stops
The MM parameter's positive-value money management logic depends on an external library, reducing readability
No position check before opening, potentially leading to duplicate positions in the same direction
The Value array indexing direction relative to CopyBuffer return order requires careful verification and is error-prone
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓
加入ATR动态止损止盈，适应市场波动率变化
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
添加信号确认机制（如多周期确认或成交量确认），减少假信号
improvements_en: Add spread filtering to pause trade opening when spread exceeds a configurable threshold
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to changing market volatility
Add position check logic to avoid duplicate openings in the same direction
Introduce signal confirmation mechanisms (e.g., multi-timeframe or volume confirmation) to reduce false signals

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高点差环境可能导致不必要的亏损
没有持仓检查可能造成重复开仓和过度敞口
固定止损止盈在不同波动率条件下可能不合适
依赖外部自定义指标ColorRMACD，若指标缺失EA将无法运行
risk_points_en: Lack of spread filtering may cause unnecessary losses in high-spread environments
No position check may lead to duplicate openings and excessive exposure
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may be inappropriate under different volatility conditions
Dependency on the external custom indicator ColorRMACD; EA cannot run if the indicator is missing

It offers four entry algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD/signal line crossover. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable buy/sell permissions and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
